query: Caranavi coffee roaster tasting notes Caturra washed
decision: [MUYU San José AAA](https://muyu.coffee/shop/p/caranavi-aaa), opened. Added Typica/Caturra/Catuai/Icatu washed regional selection, peach/clementine/hazelnut/brown sugar. The image filename contains 2026 but is not a harvest date.

[ONA Floripondio Batian](https://onacoffee.com.au/blogs/brewguides/bolivia-finca-floripondio-samaipata-batian-natural), opened. Added Batian natural and ONA's milk-roast crème brûlée/raisin/Merlot notes. [MCM](https://melbournecoffeemerchants.com.au/coffee/los-rodriguez-batian-samaipata/) independently supports regional Batian production, but its four-farm blend notes were not copied onto ONA's Floripondio. [Drop 2018 Caturra](https://www.dropcoffee.com/blogs/coffee-archive/samaichacha-caturra-bolivia-2018) opened; retained as unadopted historical comparison because its processing label is internally awkward (“washed processed without water”).

query: Loja Ecuador coffee roaster Sidra notes
decision: [Valle Andino Sidra](https://www.valleandinocoffee.com/products/sidra), opened. Farm-owned Loja roaster supplies natural Sidra; added blueberry/tropical fruit/citrus. Farm name/harvest not supplied. No Bourbon parentage inferred.

query: Pichincha Ecuador coffee roaster Typica notes
decision: [Rigby Galo Morales](https://www.rigbyroastery.com/product/ecuador-coffee-typica-mejorado), official indexed body read; direct open timeout. Orange sherbet/vanilla custard/lime and Cruz Loma Mejorado found. Held: title says anaerobic washed, body repeatedly traditional washed; exact regional link absent from this page. Existing Cruz Loma and Meridiano traceable records retained. [Midnight Bloom](https://www.midnightbloomcoffee.com/origins/ecuador-pichincha/) was rejected as a cultivar-lineage source: its Sidra ancestry assertion conflicts with better evidence.

[Burnett private-estate Gesha](https://burnettcoffee.com/products/guatemala-gesha-acatenango-90-7), opened. Added washed/patio-dried light-medium expression, jasmine/orange blossom/honey/apple/pear/white grape. Producer explicitly confidential, represented as Private estate; no fabricated farmer name, score or certification imported.

[Tiny House San Victor](https://tinyhousecoffeeroasters.com/products/guatemala), opened. Added Raul/Alejandro Molina Red Bourbon + Red Catuai, washed/patio dried, chocolate/cherry/cola. Not merged into El Santo: the same mill can handle different producer lots.

[Frazer's Kalingwe](https://www.fcrwholesale.com/product-page/uganda-rwenzori), opened. Named Kalingwe sun-dried cherry process; dried fruit/citrus/strawberry aroma. Held as extra row because existing October 2025 Kalingwe already provides producer-group traceability and no evidence makes this the same harvest. Spelling “Nyasland” was not silently used to alter old lot varieties. [Methods Rwenzori](https://methods.coffee/products/rwenzori) indexed: Kasese SL14/28 natural; redundant against current record.

query: Mount Elgon coffee roaster notes variety
decision: [Cannon Mount Elgon](https://www.cannoncoffee.co.uk/products/uganda-mt-elgon), opened. Added 200 farmers in Friends of Mother's Initiative/Dream Coffee, Mbale, washed SL14/SL28/Nyasaland, strawberry jam/cocoa. Distinct network from existing Kyagalanyi and Mountain Harvest selections.

query: Pu'er Yunnan coffee roaster Catimor notes; site:mellowcoffeeroasters.com TianHao Catimor
decision: [Mellow TianHao Red Natural](https://mellowcoffeeroasters.com/products/tianhao-red-natural-anerobic-catimor), opened. Added separate roaster selection: Catimor, low-temperature sealed fermentation then whole-cherry drying, dried fruit/whisky/brown sugar. No whisky infusion inferred. [Falcon](https://www.falconroasters.com/products/china-puer-filter) indexed page found but direct 404; not adopted.

[Ninth Red Dragon](https://ninthcoffeeroasters.com/products/red-dragon-estate-china), opened. Added separate Red Sparrow roast, Catimor anaerobic natural, chocolate/pineapple/boozy. Existing Harmony “Yun Catimor” was not rewritten: source naming is preserved per selection.

query: Chiang Rai Sirinya coffee roaster tasting; Sirinya Washed Bourbon coffee
decision: [Rolling Sirinya washed](https://rollingbkk.com/product/sirinya-washed-light-roast-200g/), official search result gives Mae Suai and pear/nectarine/orange/floral/white grape, direct browser-readable response challenge only. [RISE via Morning](https://www.drinkmorning.com/products/good-day-rise-coffee-capsules) blends washed + natural, not used to patch a single existing lot. Existing Sirinya 2025/26 cultivar/process record retained.

[Preda Soe Ae](https://www.preda-roastinghouse.com/en/blog/11197/soe-ae-drinkable-forest), opened. Added named processor Saranyu Wanasomboon, Soe Ae/Mae Tuen/Omkoi, washed 2025–2026, lime/orange/pomelo/honey/coffee blossom. Cultivar array intentionally empty: historical Typica trees in the village do not establish this selected lot's cultivar. [PRESS Ermera](https://presscoffee.com/collections/limited-single-origin/products/east-timor-ermera), official indexed body retrieved; direct open cache miss. Added washed Timor Hybrid/Typica/Catimor/Sarchimor, gingerbread/baker's chocolate/walnut. Source typo “Lefefoho” normalized to Letefoho in established Ermera geography. Producer individual absent: growers only. [Geni](https://genicoffeeroaster.com/id/products/ermera-timor-leste-for-espresso) also indexed, Catimor hybrid wash; held rather than overinterpreting proprietary hybrid-wash method.

query: Embu roaster notes; site:seycoffee.com Embu Kamavindi 2025

[RamsHead Gigeso](https://ramsheadcoffee.com/products/ethiopia-guji-shakiso-gigeso-natural), full official indexed body read. Natural local landraces, pomegranate/hibiscus/lemon balm/cocoa nib/cedar. Existing Gigesa lot kept; different roast/unknown harvest is not permission to replace its notes or landrace names. [Jones Uddeyi](https://www.jonescoffeeroasters.com/collections/frontpage/products/ethiopian-natural), indexed Tima/Shakiso producer group found, direct cache miss; held pending lot cultivar/processing details.
